Drum charts

The songs I play, charted by section.

Each chart follows the structure of the song rather than every note: one staff per section, repeat counts above, and a line of text where a part comes back. A chart fits on two A4 pages, side by side on a music stand; a long song takes three. The note heads are explained in the legend.
